summary: Verified (b) sandbox SoD/ISCM fix, persona refresh, and (c)/(d) Import Center batch queue end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: new live suite tests/test_iter22_sod_import_live.py 9/9 pass (refresh→act-as 200 for ISSO and ISSM personas, ISSO submit→ISSM approve, submitted_by_label 'the ISSO persona at …', withdraw→draft, ISSM self-submit→approve 403 'same role … submitted by the ISSM persona at …', remove endpoint 422/Not found/404); in-process pytest test_sod_persona_refresh + test_import_center_remove 8/8 pass; DB check confirms audit iscm.strategy_approved details sod/label='Sandbox: same person'. UI ISCM: as ISSO after Save+Submit → 'Pending ISSM approval', iscm-submitted-by 'Submitted by the ISSO persona at 2026-10-29 17:45 UTC', no Save draft/Submit, fields disabled, Withdraw & edit + pending note shown; Withdraw confirm text exactly as specified → Draft; switching acting-as to ISSM → only Approve/Return for changes (no save/submit/withdraw) → Approve → Approved v6 + toast. Import Center: 7 files (3 CKL, slcm, ppsm, policy, notes) → 5 Ready / 2 Needs your decision, needs-decision sorted first; chips filter (aria-pressed, toggle off, Show all files), Next button filters to needs_decision; sticky summary stays at top while scrolling (1280 and 390); Import all imported 5 ready files sequentially (POST /emass-imports + /target, 3x /uploads), paused the 2 decision files (no policy sent, zero AI spend), run summary lists every file with Open review links; eMASS files landed in review (not applied); scans have no X after send. Decisions: policy 'Remove this file' with 'apply to all' removed both policy files in one confirm; notes.txt has no apply-all (override not batch-safe) and options 'Import as policy anyway'/'Remove this file'. Per-file X, Remove selected, Clear all all confirm and call /import-center/remove; Clear all discarded the 2 eMASS imports server-side (status discarded, stored copies FileNotFound, audit import.removed_before_apply stored_copy_deleted=true). Dismissing confirm keeps the file. Layout: no horizontal overflow at 1280/390 light/dark; zero-count chips hidden on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: scrollIntoView(block:'start') puts the top of ic-files at y≈73 which is behind the sticky summary (y 93–186 at 1280) – the first decision row is partly hidden under the summary. Add scroll-margin-top (≈ summary height + header) to ic-files or scroll with offset.

sticky top-0 sits ~20px below the app header (page padding), so list content is visible scrolling through the gap above the summary (desktop and mobile). Cosmetic; consider a solid backdrop/negative top offset.

issues: The policy decision select defaults to 'Send to Policy Auditor' (AI spend). Continue only marks it Ready, but a subsequent 'Import all' then sends it. Safer default: 'Remove this file' or an empty 'Choose…' option requiring explicit selection.

design_issues.screen: Import Center rows after Import all
issues: Scan files show state 'Imported' plus a green 'Completed – next' banner although the pipeline note says 'evidence processing queued'; eMASS files also show 'Imported' while they are only in review. Consider 'Sent to review'/'Queued' wording to avoid implying data was applied (the run summary text does say nothing was applied).
Panel is a snapshot; after resolving/removing files it still shows the old states (e.g. 'Needs your decision' for files now Removed).

action_items: LOW: offset the 'Next: review' scroll so the first needs-decision row is not hidden under the sticky summary
LOW: default the policy decision to a non-AI option (or blank) to avoid accidental AI spend via Import all
LOW (optional): 'Imported' → 'Sent to review'/'Queued' wording for routed files; refresh or label the run-summary as a snapshot
critical_code_review_comments: useImportQueue.remove maps server 'skipped' results back by file_name – two queued files with the same name (e.g. same file uploaded twice) would both be marked skipped/removed together; key by index or a client key instead.

resolve(all=true) for kind 'target' applies 'Update the selected system anyway' to every mismatched eMASS file even though each file may have a different mismatch prompt; acceptable as batchSafe per spec but worth confirming.
IscmStrategy isIssm also checks user.roles – for real (non-sandbox) users holding both ISSO and ISSM roles the Withdraw button is hidden; fine for the sandbox, verify intended for real orgs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 2 low-priority UX issues

seed_data_creation: Demo sandbox: LTP ISCM strategy went through several submit/approve cycles (ends Approved v6, unchanged content). 3 CKL scans sent to LTP ingest (ingest runs, not removable by design). All eMASS imports created were discarded via Clear all; no eMASS imports left in review for the demo tenant. No policies sent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live suite tests/test_iter22_sod_import_live.py runs against preview with --noconftest (uses demo-login, LTP). Note: ISSO calling /iscm/decision gets 403 'Only the ISSM of this system approves…' (role check precedes SoD), so the same-role SoD message is only reachable via ISSM self-submit. Auth playbook items (cookies/lockout) not re-tested this iteration – app uses bearer JWT; avoid lockout tests on the shared demo account.
